MiniMaxH3TimelinePlanner.description: Arrange reference video, images, and audio on a timeline and emit a reusable material plan.

import_preset.name: Import Preset
import_preset.tooltip: Optional preset from the Local Preset Loader.

prompt_index.name: Prompt Index
prompt_index.tooltip: Optional 1-based segment index used to select that segment's assigned images and audio.

generation_seconds.name: Generation Duration
generation_seconds.tooltip: Duration of the cyan generation selection.

MiniMaxH3PresetLoader.description: Find a local timeline preset and feed it into the Material Planner.

MiniMaxH3PresetExporter.description: Save timeline configuration alone or with all referenced media in a portable local folder.

MiniMaxH3OmniPromptBridge.display_name: MiniMax H3 Omni Media Prompt Bridge
MiniMaxH3OmniPromptBridge.description: Send a material bundle to MiniMax-H3 Prompt Rewriter Omni without creating a graph cycle.

MiniMaxH3TimelineEncoder.description: Encode a material plan and prompt into MiniMax H3 conditioning and latent inputs.

2.name: Merged Video Audio
2.tooltip: Source audio mixed from timeline video references.

3.name: Merged Standalone Audio
3.tooltip: Independent reference audio concatenated in numbered order.

MiniMaxH3TimelineDirector.description: Compatibility node combining the material planner and plan encoder.

MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentExpansion.description: Legacy compatibility. Edit windows, materials and prompts in Material Planner and connect Segment Plan directly to Finite Segment Sampler.

MiniMaxH3FiniteAudioTrimTail.display_name: MiniMax H3 Finite Audio Tail Trim (Internal)

MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentSampler.description: Sample every planned segment with Drift-Control continuation. auto execution uses a Director-style one-segment loop from 8 windows so extra-long multi-segment 0.4 MP jobs do not expand a full DAG. Each clip spills to mp4; re-queue resumes from output/minimax_seg_cache.

export_mode.name: Export Mode
export_mode.tooltip: segments: write each clip to output/minimax_seg_export as soon as it finishes (crash-safe). all: keep clips in temp and only assemble the final video.

output_megapixels.name: Output Megapixels
output_megapixels.tooltip: 0 keeps planner resolution. With h3_latent + Refine Steps, each window is 3D-lifted and T8-sampled at about 1920x1088. VSR methods upscale pixels instead.

upscale_method.name: Upscale Method
upscale_method.tooltip: h3_latent: Director-style 3D lift then T8 at 2.0 with previous-tail re-pin (sequential). nvidia_rtx_vsr/lanczos/bicubic upscale pixels.

refine_denoise.name: Refine Denoise
refine_denoise.tooltip: With h3_latent: T8 at the output canvas after lift and re-pin. With VSR: light resample at planner resolution before upscale. 0 skips T8.

face_refine.name: Face Refine
face_refine.tooltip: Optional. Connect MiniMax H3 Director FaceRefine. Unconnected skips this. Same MiniMax H3 UNET on a ~768 face crop, after 2.0 VSR so the stitch lands on final pixels. Keep Material Planner secondPass off.

execution_mode.name: Execution Mode
execution_mode.tooltip: auto: switch to a one-segment loop from 8 segments (avoids extra-long multi-segment graph OOM); 1–7 stay expanded. sequential: always loop. graph: always expand (OOMs on long timelines).

clear_vram_between_segments.name: Clear VRAM Between Segments
clear_vram_between_segments.tooltip: Unload models and empty the CUDA cache after each sequential segment. Ignored in graph mode.

cache_name.name: Cache Name
cache_name.tooltip: Optional folder under output/minimax_seg_cache. Empty uses a hash of the plan and seed. Re-queue after OOM to resume finished segments.

live_preview.name: Live Preview
live_preview.tooltip: KJ-style tiny-VAE preview on this sampler while it samples. No extra node. Put MiniMax-H3-TAE.safetensors in models/vae_approx.

preview_tiny_vae.name: Preview Tiny VAE
preview_tiny_vae.tooltip: auto picks MiniMax-H3-TAE.safetensors or taeh3.safetensors. none uses Latent2RGB.

preview_max_resolution.name: Preview Max Resolution
preview_max_resolution.tooltip: Max preview side in pixels. 0 = no downscale.

preview_frames.name: Preview Frames
preview_frames.tooltip: Animated frames per step. 1 = still. Raise toward clip length (e.g. 241) for a full-clip loop.

preview_fps.name: Preview FPS
preview_fps.tooltip: Playback FPS for the animated preview. Ignored when Preview Frames is 1.

MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentVideoSampler.display_name: MiniMax H3 Finite Segment Sampler (Low Memory)
MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentVideoSampler.description: Decode and encode one segment at a time. export_mode=segments writes crash-safe clips to output/minimax_seg_export.

export_mode.name: Export Mode
export_mode.tooltip: segments: write each clip to output/minimax_seg_export as soon as it finishes (crash-safe). all: keep clips in temp and only assemble the final video.

execution_mode.name: Execution Mode
execution_mode.tooltip: auto: sequential loop from 8 segments. sequential: always loop. graph: always expand (OOMs on long timelines).

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopInitialize.description: Create the finite-segment carried state for ComfyUI's native Start Loop.

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopSegment.description: Select this iteration's material plan, prompt, and overlap settings.

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopPrepare.description: Apply previous latent continuation, Drift-Control, and fixed audio before user-selected sampling nodes.

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopAccumulate.description: Remove the duplicate opening, merge this segment, and carry state through native End Loop.

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopOutput.description: Return the final video, audio, and last latent from native End Loop state.

MiniMaxH3AddLatentGuide.description: Copy a valid temporal block directly from one H3 AV latent into another.

MiniMaxH3VisualDifferenceMetrics.description: Compare two RGB frame batches and report color and pixel differences.

MiniMaxH3WindowedRefine.description: Second-pass 0.4 to 2.0 on overlapping H3 windows. Each window is 3D-lifted, the previous 2.0 AV tail is re-pinned, then T8 samples at the output canvas. Never encodes the whole 2.0 clip through H3. 12+ segments: connect first-pass Final Video; Merged Frames is an 8x8 stub.

images.name: Images
images.tooltip: 0.4 Merged Frames when the first pass kept them. Optional if First-pass Video is connected.

finite_plan.name: Finite Segment Plan
finite_plan.tooltip: Optional. Supplies canvas size and the 3D upscaler. First-pass boxes longer than Window Frames are split. Raise Window Frames to the segment length to run a whole box if VRAM allows.

source_video.name: First-pass Video
source_video.tooltip: Connect the first-pass Final Video. Used when Merged Frames is the 8x8 omit stub (12+ segments).

output_megapixels.name: Output Megapixels
output_megapixels.tooltip: Refine canvas. 2.0 is sharpest and heaviest. Drop to 1.5 / 1.0 before picking a longer window or whole 15s.

upscale_method.name: Upscale Method
upscale_method.tooltip: h3_latent: 3D lift (softer, 16GB-safe). nvidia_rtx_vsr: original dual-pass VSR then light T8. Window size is whatever you set on Window Frames. Needs nvidia-vfx.

refine_denoise.name: Refine Denoise
refine_denoise.tooltip: T8 denoise after 3D lift. 0 skips T8.

refine_steps.name: Refine Steps
refine_steps.tooltip: 0 with h3_latent = 3D lift then decode, no T8 sample.

window_frames.name: Window Size
window_frames.tooltip: Dropdown, not a typed number. 5.9s is typical at 2.0 on 16GB. Drop Output Megapixels before picking a longer window or whole 15s.

overlap_frames.name: Overlap Frames
overlap_frames.tooltip: H3-legal: 5 / 22 / 39 / 56. 39 ≈ 1.6s, 56 ≈ 2.3s. Exactly 2s (48 frames) is not valid.

latent_upscale_model.name: Latent Upscale Model
latent_upscale_model.tooltip: Used when Upscale Method is h3_latent. auto picks a compatible H3 checkpoint.

split_long_windows.name: Split Long Lift Windows
split_long_windows.tooltip: Lift-only: split boxes longer than Window Frames. Off keeps one lift per first-pass box. T8 already splits to Window Frames.

live_preview.name: Live Preview
live_preview.tooltip: KJ-style tiny-VAE preview on this node while T8 samples. No extra node.

preview_tiny_vae.name: Preview Tiny VAE
preview_tiny_vae.tooltip: auto picks MiniMax-H3-TAE.safetensors or taeh3.safetensors. none uses Latent2RGB.

preview_max_resolution.name: Preview Max Resolution
preview_max_resolution.tooltip: Max preview side in pixels. 0 = no downscale.

preview_frames.name: Preview Frames
preview_frames.tooltip: Animated frames per step. 1 = still. Raise toward clip length (e.g. 241) for a full-clip loop.

preview_fps.name: Preview FPS
preview_fps.tooltip: Playback FPS for the animated preview. Ignored when Preview Frames is 1.

MiniMaxH3LivePreviewAttach.description: Internal. Wraps MODEL so sampling previews stream to Finite Segment Sampler or Windowed Refine.
